channel.title: Paksh: Politics
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: GOP Ad Buyer Misfires, Spends $25,000 in Wrong Portland
item.description: Allies of Maine Senator Susan Collins mistakenly spent $25,000 on an advertisement targeting her rival in Portland, Oregon, instead of Portland, Maine. The ad buyer confused the two cities, leading to the misdirected expenditure. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: European elections show a shift towards right-wing parties
item.description: European elections indicate a trend towards right-wing political parties across the continent. Coverage highlights this shift, with some outlets framing it as a "test case to ‘unite the Right." Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: British Columbia Premier David Eby has warned against health care privatization, likening potential moves to U.S.-style systems. The Conservatives have responded by accusing Eby of 'fearmongering.' Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
